quizzes.title: Welcome Quiz
quizzes.description: A short practice quiz so students can try the timer, every question type, the answer review and the certificate.

questions.prompt: What is the first pillar of Islam?
questions.explanation: The Shahada, bearing witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is His Messenger, is the first pillar of Islam.

questions.prompt: The Quran was revealed over approximately 23 years.
questions.explanation: The Quran was revealed to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) gradually over about 23 years.

questions.prompt: Name the holy book of Islam (one word).
questions.explanation: The Quran is the holy book of Islam. Different spellings such as Qur'an are accepted.

questions.prompt: Which of these are books of Hadith? (select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim and Sunan Abu Dawud are Hadith collections. The Injil (Gospel) is a scripture given to Prophet Isa (Jesus).

questions.prompt: Match each pillar of Islam to its meaning.
questions.explanation: Salah is the five daily prayers, Sawm is fasting in Ramadan, Zakat is obligatory charity, and Hajj is the pilgrimage to Makkah.

questions.prompt: The Quran has ___ surahs, and the first surah is called ___.
questions.explanation: There are 114 surahs in the Quran. The first is Al-Fatiha (The Opening).

questions.prompt: Put the five daily prayers in order, starting from dawn.
Which picture shows the crescent moon (hilal) that marks the start of an Islamic month?
questions.explanation: Islamic months begin when the new crescent moon (hilal) is sighted, which is why the crescent (Picture B) is the answer.
